newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends touch firmer, session thin.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends touch firmer, session thin.

text.p: White sugar futures ended Thursday marginally firmer but the thin session was generally thin and contracts moved in tight ranges.
Spot October accounted for the bulk of the turnover but much of this came in the form of Oct/March spread trading, with little interest seen in the second-month December contract.
October closed 20 cents firmer at $327.90 and December up $1.20 at $324.00. Volume amounted to a light 819 lots.
Traders said fund players in the London whites market were content to remain sidelined for the time being as they had already increased their long positions.
October sell-stops were thought to be placed at around $323 and below where the contract was well supported, they added.
